title: Quant pipeline: FP8/INT8 calibration, accuracy validation and throughput-latency synthesis for long-context + batching
creator: Diego Patel
description: Purpose: Build a reproducible benchmark and calibration pipeline that measures throughput and latency trade-offs for FP8 and INT8 variants across realistic batching patterns and long-context workloads. Problem: Prior runs show divergent results when combining aggressive batching and KV-cache warmup for long-context inference; calibration artifacts (per-channel scale, bias correction) change accuracy distributions and occasionally induce tail-latency spikes. Goal: produce a clear matrix of accuracy vs unit-cost for each quant profile, produce a roll-forward recommendation (preferred quant profile per workload class), and deliver a runbook + autotune knobs for Runtime engineers and Dedicated customers.
acceptance_criteria: Automated pipeline that runs matrix (models x quant_profiles x batch_sizes x context_lengths) end-to-end and emits standardized CSV/JSON artifacts
Accuracy regression <= 2% (relative) on our canonical evaluation suite (QA+LM likelihood + embedding drift) for selected quant profiles
p95 tail latency degradation <= 2x compared to fp16 baseline for same throughput target on H100/A100 instances
Throughput / token-cost report with recommendations for runtime default profiles and customer presets
PR with calibration artifacts + scripts merged and confluence doc with runbook and interpretation guide published
experiment_matrix: Quant profiles: FP8 E4M3 (dynamic range tuning), INT8 per-channel symmetric, INT8 per-channel asymmetric with bias correction
Context lengths: [512, 2048, 8192] to capture cold start vs steady-state KV cache behavior
Hardware: A100-80GB, H100-80GB (single-GPU and 2x-GPU NUMA pinning tests)
Workloads: chat-style (many short turns), long-window document completion, embedding+rerank hotspots
KV warm states: cold (no prior cache), warm (prefilled with 1-4k tokens), hot (continuous stream)
Metrics collected: tokens/sec, p50/p95/p99 latency, memory usage, GPU utilization, quantization-induced perplexity delta, embedding cosine drift, token-error rate on QA prompts
comments: 2026-03-10 - Diego Patel: Initial ticket created after triage with PM. Hypothesis: FP8 provides ~2-3x token-cost reduction but calibration must be tuned per-layer to avoid drift in embedding space. Requesting A100/H100 capacity allocation for benchmark runs.

2026-03-11 - Ava Morgan: Captured experiment matrix and added long-context corpora. Started implementing calibration pipeline (per-channel histogram + KL selection + bias-correction step). Local smoke runs show INT8 asymmetric reduces memory but introduces small LM likelihood bias in layernorm-heavy layers.

2026-03-12 - Lina Kapoor (PM): Please include a customer-facing summary section in Confluence with recommended default profiles for Hosted API and Dedicated customers. Also add a 'rollback' conservative profile for safety.

2026-03-13 - Ava Morgan: Found cause for p95 spikes: dynamic batching coalescing + KV cache refill causes mutex contention in stream aggregator. Mitigation: add backoff in coalescer and cap batch assembly time for long-context paths. Running regression now.

2026-03-14 - Diego Patel: End-to-end harness completed for batch sizes [1,2,4,8]; initial results: FP8 E4M3 meets accuracy threshold on llama-2-13b-chat for context=2048 with batch<=4 but p95 increased by 1.7x on A100. Draft PR open (see artifacts). Next: run 8k context, verify embedding drift on rerank tasks.
